content.text: Ashwani Kumar Indian Player Overview 2025 IPL Debut Bowler Specialization 29 August 2001 Date of Birth 8 Matches Overview Schedule Results Squad News Archive About  Copy Born on August 29, 2001, in the village of Jhanjeri, Punjab, Ashwani Kumar is a dynamic left-arm fast-medium bowler whose rise from the hinterlands of Mohali to the bright lights of the Wankhede is nothing short of inspirational. He is an impressive bowler due to his ability to generate extra bounce and natural late swing, complemented by a sharp yorker and deceptive back-of-the-hand slower balls. Ashwani grabbed everyone’s attention with a historic IPL debut in 2025 against Kolkata Knight Riders. He became the first Indian bowler to claim a four-wicket haul on debut (4/24), stunning the cricketing world by taking a wicket with his very first delivery. Throughout his debut year for Mumbai Indians, he proved to be a consistent threat, claiming 11 wickets in just seven innings and establishing himself as a reliable death-overs specialist. As Mumbai Indians hunt for their record-extending 6th title in 2026, Ashwani will be crucial to strengthening their bowling core and strike with his early breakthroughs in the powerplay.
